rationale: The study camera (CAM-I2, fw 2.0, protocol v3) is identical to the working Hall Cam and is firmware-compatible with the base station, yet remains offline despite a factory reset, being placed next to the base station (RSSI -60 dBm), a different outlet, and a different cable. No error codes are logged and all other devices are online, ruling out network, pairing, firmware, and signal causes, leaving a hardware fault as the likely cause.

output.suspected_root_cause: Hardware fault in the Study Cam, as all other potential causes (network, pairing, firmware, signal) have been ruled out.

results.text: All devices offline, base station LED solid red. Router had been replaced the previous day and the Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. Resolved at frontline.

Hold SYNC for 15 seconds until the LED flashes white. This removes the peripheral's own binding but does not remove it from the base station table; remove it in the app first, then reset, then pair again.

Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.

Solid blue: online and connected to cloud. Blinking blue: pairing mode (lasts 120 seconds). Solid red: no internet uplink. Blinking red: booting or firmware update in progress, do not unplug. Solid purple: storage almost full (over 95 percent).

results.text: After HB-200 auto-updated to 4.5, a CAM-I2 running 1.2 disconnected with E-305. OTA not offered for this hardware revision. Escalated; FAE confirmed protocol v2 dropped and arranged a compatibility firmware. Escalated correctly.

complaint: My study camera is still broken even beside the base station after resetting the camera. I carried it into the same room as the base station, plugged it in and held the reset button for 10 seconds as the manual says; the LED goes solid and then dark again. I also tried a different power outlet and a different cable. Everything else in the system works.
